# youtrack_mailbox (Resource)

Manages a mailbox of the YouTrack mailbox integration: a mail account YouTrack polls for emails, which its mail rules (`youtrack_mail_rule`) turn into issues and comments. IMAP(S) and POP(S) mailboxes use `host`, `port`, `login` and `password`; Microsoft Exchange Online (`OFFICE365`) mailboxes use the `microsoft_*` attributes. Deleting a mailbox also deletes its mail rules.

## Example Usage

```terraform
variable "support_mailbox_password" {
  type      = string
  sensitive = true
}

variable "exchange_client_secret" {
  type      = string
  sensitive = true
}

# An IMAP mailbox.
resource "youtrack_mailbox" "support" {
  protocol = "IMAPS"
  host     = "imap.example.com"
  port     = 993
  login    = "support@example.com"
  password = var.support_mailbox_password
}

# A Microsoft Exchange Online mailbox, read through a Microsoft Entra ID app.
resource "youtrack_mailbox" "helpdesk" {
  protocol                  = "OFFICE365"
  microsoft_mailbox_address = "helpdesk@example.com"
  microsoft_client_id       = "00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000"
  microsoft_tenant_id       = "11111111-1111-1111-1111-111111111111"
  microsoft_client_secret   = var.exchange_client_secret
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `protocol` (String) Mail protocol: `IMAP`, `IMAPS`, `OFFICE365` (Microsoft Exchange Online), or the deprecated `POP` and `POPS`. Changing it replaces the mailbox.

### Optional

- `connection_timeout` (Number) Connection timeout, in seconds (YouTrack defaults to 30, at most 300 on a stock instance).
- `exchange_compatibility_mode` (Boolean) Whether to work around the IMAP quirks of Microsoft Exchange servers. Defaults to false.
- `host` (String) Mail server host name. Required for every protocol except `OFFICE365`.
- `login` (String) Login of the mail account. Required for every protocol except `OFFICE365`.
- `microsoft_client_id` (String) Application (client) ID of the Microsoft Entra ID app YouTrack reads the mailbox with. Required for `OFFICE365`.
- `microsoft_client_secret` (String, Sensitive) Client secret of the Microsoft Entra ID app. Required for `OFFICE365`. This value is write-only and is not returned by the API.
- `microsoft_mailbox_address` (String) Email address of the Exchange Online mailbox. Required for `OFFICE365`.
- `microsoft_tenant_id` (String) Directory (tenant) ID of the Microsoft Entra ID app. Required for `OFFICE365`.
- `password` (String, Sensitive) Password of the mail account. Required for every protocol except `OFFICE365`. This value is write-only and is not returned by the API.
- `port` (Number) Mail server port. Required for every protocol except `OFFICE365`.
- `socket_timeout` (Number) Socket timeout, in seconds (YouTrack defaults to 30, at most 300 on a stock instance).

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Mailbox ID.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
#!/bin/sh
# Import a mailbox by its ID. The password and the Microsoft client secret are
# write-only: set them in the configuration, the next apply sends them again.
terraform import youtrack_mailbox.support 254-0
```
